svg.title: Круговые движения тазобедренным суставом — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Standing hip controlled articular rotation, front three-quarter. Same standing leg and hand on support post throughout. LEFT lift free knee bent 90 degrees directly in front of hip. RIGHT sweep same bent knee outward laterally with foot off floor, pelvis and trunk stay facing forward. Two snapshots from same controlled circular path, no graphic arrows or extra legs. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
